description.plain:
Card 1 — Use case & problem

Industry / user persona — Bulk Freight, Mining Logistics & Industrial Manufacturing · Commercial Auditors, Transporters, Fleet Drivers, Yard Receivers.

Problem (3 bullets) — • Paper Proof-of-Delivery Bottleneck: Physical bilties take 10–14 days to courier from remote siding gates to headquarters, delaying billing cycles and freezing carrier cash flow.
• Weighbridge Variance & Transit Leakage: Discrepancies between origin siding tare/gross and destination customer weighments cause unrecovered transit shrinkage.
• Manual Data Entry & Invoice Discrepancies: Accounts Payable re-keys paper bilties into SAP MIRO, producing data entry errors, GST mismatches, and carrier disputes.

What we solve (max 2 lines) — PODZO eliminates paper courier lag by combining automated weighbridge scale telemetry, driver mobile AI OCR stamp verification, and automated SAP S/4HANA MIRO invoice settlement.

Tech stack tags (comma list) — SAP BTP Cloud Foundry, Node.js / TypeScript, React 19, SQLite / SAP HANA Cloud, OpenAI Vision API / SAP GenAI Hub, Tesseract OCR, Tailwind CSS, SAP S/4HANA OData & BAPIs

SAP touchpoints (modules, tables, APIs) — SAP MM, SD, FI-AP · Tables: VBAK, VBAP, LIKP, LIPS, EKKO, EKPO, RBKP, RSEG · APIs: BAPI_INCOMINGINVOICE_CREATE1 (MIRO), BAPI_GOODSMVT_CREATE (MIGO), Sales Order & Delivery OData Services

Image (optional) + caption — podzo_c1_1.png — End-to-end logistics friction vs. AI-driven touchless automated settlement.

Bot lines — Line 1: Traditional bulk logistics suffers from 14-day courier delays and frequent weighbridge weight disputes.
Line 2: PODZO digitizes the entire chain, matching origin weights to destination offload in real time.
Line 3: Clean, verified deliveries flow directly into automated SAP S/4HANA financial settlement.

Figure [podzo_c1_1.png]: Traditional bulk logistics friction vs. AI-driven touchless automated settlement.

🤖 Bot Explains: Traditional bulk freight logistics relies on paper bilties that delay billing by two weeks. PODZO digitizes the process end-to-end with automated weighing and AI verification.

description.plain:
Card 3 — How it works (3-step flow)

Step 1 title + 1 line — Step 1: S/4HANA Order Distribution & Fleet Dispatch — Commercial Auditor distributes SAP Sales Orders to transporters; drivers receive digital dispatch passes with origin gross/tare weighment.

Step 2 title + 1 line — Step 2: Dual Weighbridge Telemetry & Yard Offload — Trucks offload at customer siding; destination weighbridge captures net payload and verifies tolerance threshold automatically.

Step 3 title + 1 line — Step 3: AI Decision OCR & Automated MIRO Settlement — Driver uploads stamped bilty; AI validates receiver stamp and matches weights, triggering automated SAP MIRO invoice posting.

Flow image file + caption — podzo_c3_1.png — 3-step operational workflow from SAP Sales Order allocation to automated MIRO invoice posting.

Bot chat — Msg 1: First, sales orders sync from SAP S/4HANA, enabling instant fleet and driver scheduling.
Msg 2: Next, dual weighbridge scales at origin and destination capture weight telemetry without manual entry.
Msg 3: Finally, AI extracts the stamped bilty, performs a 3-way match, and parks/posts the MIRO invoice in SAP.

Figure [podzo_c3_1.png]: 3-step operational workflow from SAP Sales Order allocation to automated MIRO invoice posting.

🤖 Bot Explains: The workflow seamlessly connects SAP S/4HANA sales orders, weighbridge scale telemetry, and automated finance settlement.

description.plain:
Card 4 — Key features

Feature 1: title, 1 line, image file — Feature 1: AI Decision Intelligence OCR Engine — Multimodal Vision extracts invoice header, line items, and verifies official customer receiver stamp with 99% accuracy. (podzo_c4_1.png)

Feature 2: title, 1 line, image file — Feature 2: Dual Weighbridge Tolerance Reconciliation — Compares origin siding gross/tare against destination yard offload with configurable ±0.5% tolerance gates. (podzo_c4_2.png)

Feature 3: title, 1 line, image file — Feature 3: Automated S/4HANA MIRO Invoicing — One-click automated AP clearance via BAPI_INCOMINGINVOICE_CREATE1, generating parked or posted SAP financial documents. (podzo_c4_3.png)

Bot chat — Msg 1: Our AI vision model extracts 14 invoice fields and confirms the physical stamped seal in seconds.
Msg 2: Weight reconciliation flags moisture loss or shrinkage before transporter payment is approved.
Msg 3: Approved deliveries post straight to SAP FI-AP as MIRO invoices with full audit trails.

Figure [podzo_c4_1.png]: Driver mobile POD upload interface with AI OCR extraction and stamp recognition.

🤖 Bot Explains: Drivers capture physical bilties on their phones. Our AI engine verifies receiver stamps and extracts delivery line items instantly.

description.plain:
Card 5 — Architecture & integration

Architecture diagram file + caption — podzo_c5_1.png — High-availability cloud-to-on-premise architecture on SAP BTP Cloud Foundry and SAP S/4HANA.

Systems connected — SAP S/4HANA on-premise (S21 System, Client 200 via Cloud Connector), SAP BTP Cloud Foundry Runtime, SAP GenAI Hub / OpenAI Vision API, Weighbridge IoT Scale REST Bridges, SQLite / SAP HANA Cloud.

Auth / security (XSUAA, JWT, destinations…) — SAP BTP XSUAA OAuth 2.0 / JWT Role-Based Access Control (CA, TA, DR, CR, SR, SA), TLS 1.3 encrypted REST destinations, AES-256 encrypted credential vault, Cloud Connector mutual TLS tunnel.

Bot chat — Msg 1: PODZO runs as a multi-tier microservice on SAP BTP Cloud Foundry with sub-second response times.
Msg 2: It securely communicates with on-premise SAP S/4HANA via SAP Cloud Connector using OAuth JWT.
Msg 3: Sensitive logistics and financial data remain completely encrypted in-transit and at-rest.

Figure [podzo_c5_1.png]: Enterprise Solution Architecture connecting SAP S/4HANA to SAP BTP Cloud Foundry.

🤖 Bot Explains: PODZO bridges on-premise SAP S/4HANA and cloud services through SAP Cloud Connector and secure OAuth JWT authentication.

description.plain:
Card 6 — Results & ROI

Headline metric — 98% Touchless Delivery-to-Invoice Clearance & 85% Reduction in Billing Lead Time

Before → after — Before: 12–14 days paper courier & manual 3-way match → After: 4 hours from truck offload to SAP MIRO invoice posting.

Supporting metrics (up to 3) — Metric 1: Zero Unrecovered Weight Leakage — Automated dual weighbridge audit prevents $180K+ annual transit shrinkage losses.
Metric 2: 70% Reduction in AP Processing Costs — Touchless OCR matching eliminates manual invoice data entry across thousands of monthly trips.
Metric 3: 100% Audit Compliance & Dispute Elimination — Cryptographically verified stamps and weighbridge tickets resolve carrier disputes immediately.

Source of numbers (client / pilot / estimate) — Verified customer pilot metrics across industrial mining logistics and bulk pharmaceutical distribution contracts.

Bot chat — Msg 1: Customers cut invoice processing time from two weeks down to under four hours.
Msg 2: Real-time dual weighbridge checks immediately stop unrecovered transit loss and short deliveries.
Msg 3: Accounting teams process thousands of monthly transport bilties with 98% touchless automation.

Figure [podzo_c6_1.png]: Business Value and Executive KPI Scorecard for touchless transport invoice automation.

🤖 Bot Explains: Automating the delivery reconciliation chain reduces invoice dispute cycle time by 85% and eliminates transit leakage.

description.plain:
Card 7 — Prerequisites & next step

BTP services + entitlements — SAP BTP Cloud Foundry Runtime (1 GB Memory / 2 GB Disk), SAP Authorization & Trust Management (XSUAA standard), SAP Destination Service (lite), SAP Cloud Connector (connectivity standard), SAP AI Core / GenAI Hub (optional for on-tenant LLM).

S/4HANA config / authorizations — SAP S/4HANA 1909+ or ECC 6.0 EHP7+; Technical User with RFC authorizations for BAPI_INCOMINGINVOICE_CREATE1, BAPI_GOODSMVT_CREATE, OData services for Sales Orders (SD) & Deliveries (LE).

Time to deploy — 2 to 3 weeks for complete pilot integration with live S/4HANA system and weighbridge scales.

CTA button label + link — Launch Live Demo Portal (https://podzone-forgiving-cheetah-ja.cfapps.eu30.hana.ondemand.com)

Bot closing line — Ready to eliminate logistics invoice delays? Let’s schedule a personalized 14-day proof-of-value for your enterprise!

Figure [podzo_c7_1.png]: Prerequisites and SAP BTP deployment topology blueprint.

🤖 Bot Explains: Deploying PODZO requires standard SAP BTP Cloud Foundry runtime and Cloud Connector access to your SAP S/4HANA instance.
